figures.caption: 圖：為布置比賽忙碌的教室
figures.description: 放學後的教室裡，大家正在為教室布置比賽做準備。一個男生站在椅子上，把彩色紙鏈掛在窗戶上方；兩個女生在後面的牆上貼一張寫著班級口號「一起變更好」的大海報；一個學生把幾盆小盆栽擺在窗台上；黑板前一個女生用彩色粉筆畫黑板畫，畫的是一棵大樹，每片樹葉上都寫著一位同學的名字。地上放著剪刀、膠帶和紙箱。

questions.stem: 提示：學校舉辦教室布置比賽，各班同學分工合作，想讓教室變得更溫馨。請仔細看下面的圖片，寫一篇英文作文，文分兩段。第一段描述圖中的學生們如何布置教室；第二段寫出你和同學一起布置教室或準備班級活動的一次經驗，並提出你想如何布置自己教室的簡單計畫與理由。

1.explanation_zh: 這一題有三個要求：第一段描述圖中的布置工作（掛紙鏈、貼海報、擺盆栽、畫黑板畫）；第二段先寫一次和同學一起布置或準備活動的經驗，再提出自己想怎麼布置教室的簡單計畫，並說明理由。計畫要具體（放什麼、放在哪裡），理由要說明對同學有什麼好處。
evidence: 第一段描述圖中的學生們如何布置教室
提出你想如何布置自己教室的簡單計畫與理由
1.strategy_zh: 經驗用過去式寫，接著用 If our class joined …, I would … 帶出計畫；計畫至少寫兩項具體的布置，再用一句話說明理由。
hints: 第一段：First, a boy is … Then … Meanwhile, …
第二段前半：Last …, my classmates and I decorated … 我負責什麼
第二段後半：If our class joined a decoration contest, I would … 接具體做法與理由

moves.zh: 描述圖中的學生們如何布置教室
寫出你和同學一起布置教室或準備班級活動的一次經驗
提出你想如何布置自己教室的簡單計畫與理由

content.focus_zh: 第一段寫出至少三項布置工作；第二段要有一次具體的布置或準備經驗，以及一個具體的布置計畫（放什麼、放哪裡）和理由。

bands.descriptor_zh: 回應題目的每一項要求，主旨明確；用具體的事例、細節或親身經驗撐起每個重點。
大致回應題目，但有一項要求寫得單薄，或細節偏籠統、說服力不足。
漏掉題目的主要要求或主旨模糊，多數句子空泛、重複或偏離題目。
空白、離題、只抄題目，或內容少到無法判斷要說什麼。

organization.focus_zh: 第二段先經驗、後計畫，用 If 句自然轉接；計畫的細節與理由要前後呼應，結尾回到教室帶給大家的感覺。

bands.descriptor_zh: 兩段分工清楚，各有主題句；句與句、段與段的銜接自然，轉承語用得恰當，篇幅分配合理。
段落大致分明，但有的地方跳接或重複，轉承語偏少或用得生硬。
重點排列混亂，前後句常接不起來，讀者不容易跟上。
看不出段落與順序，句子彼此無關。

grammar.focus_zh: 圖片用現在進行式，經驗用過去式，計畫用 would＋原形動詞；put up、hang 等動詞的時態要一致。

bands.descriptor_zh: 句子幾乎沒有文法、標點錯誤，能交替使用簡單句、複句與不同的句首。
偶有時態、單複數或標點錯誤，但讀得懂意思；句型變化有限。
錯誤多到常讓人誤解意思，句子結構常不完整。
幾乎沒有正確的句子，無法理解。

vocabulary.focus_zh: 布置、海報、盆栽、粉筆等字（decorate、poster、plant、chalk）要拼對；避免一直重複 make 和 nice。

bands.descriptor_zh: 用字精準、貼切，搭配自然，少有重複；拼字與大小寫幾乎全對。
字彙範圍偏窄、常重複同幾個字，偶有用字不當或拼錯，但不妨礙理解。
用錯字或拼錯字很多，常讓人看不懂。
幾乎每個字都用錯或拼錯，無法理解。

rubric.deductions_zh: 字數明顯不足（少於 100 個單詞）或沒有分成兩段，各扣總分 1 分；兩種情形同時發生只扣 1 分。離題或空白以 0 分計。

sentence_starters: The picture shows a class getting ready for ...
Last ..., my classmates and I decorated ...
If our class joined a decoration contest, I would ...

model_texts.label: steady
model_texts.text:
The picture shows a class getting ready for a classroom decoration contest. Everyone has a different job. First, a boy is standing on a chair and hanging colorful paper chains above the windows. Then two girls are putting up a big poster with their class slogan on the back wall. Meanwhile, another student is placing some small plants by the window. In front of the blackboard, a girl is drawing a big tree with colored chalk. There are scissors, tape, and boxes on the floor, so they must be very busy.
Last December, my classmates and I decorated our classroom for Christmas. I was in charge of making paper snowflakes, and I cut more than thirty of them in one afternoon. When we finished, our classroom looked warm and bright, and I felt very proud. If our class joined a decoration contest, I would make a reading corner at the back of the classroom. For example, we could put a small bookshelf and two soft cushions there. I would also hang some of our own drawings on the wall. Although this plan is simple, it would give us a comfortable place to read and relax. In conclusion, I believe a reading corner would make our classroom feel like home.

self_assessment.explanation_zh: 圖中的布置工作、自己的經驗與閱讀角計畫都寫到，計畫有具體做法（內容 4）；先經驗後計畫，順序清楚（組織 4）；時態與 would 的用法正確，句型較簡單（文法句構 4）；用字正確但偏基礎（字彙拼字 3）。總分 15，屬穩健版。

model_texts.label: top
model_texts.text:
With the decoration contest only a day away, the classroom in the picture has turned into a busy workshop. Nobody is sitting still. Balancing on a chair, a boy is hanging chains of colorful paper above the windows, while two girls at the back are carefully putting up a large poster of their class motto. Meanwhile, another student is arranging small potted plants along the windowsill, adding a touch of green to the room. At the front, a girl is turning the blackboard into a work of art, drawing a tall tree with colored chalk. Every leaf on it carries the name of a classmate. Scissors, tape, and empty cardboard boxes are scattered across the floor. In short, everyone has clearly been working hard.
Last December, my class spent three afternoons preparing for a Christmas party, and the experience taught me that decorating is really about teamwork. At first, everyone wanted to do the fun parts, such as painting, and nobody volunteered to clean up. Our class leader solved the problem by writing every task on a slip of paper and letting us draw lots. I ended up cutting out forty paper snowflakes, a job I would never have chosen, yet it turned out to be surprisingly relaxing. If we joined a decoration contest, my plan would be simple: I would turn the back corner of our classroom into a reading area. To begin with, a small bookshelf filled with books donated by classmates would encourage us to read during breaks. In addition, a few cushions and a string of soft lights would make the corner cozy without costing much. Admittedly, a reading corner may not impress the judges as much as a giant painting. However, a classroom should be designed for the people who spend eight hours in it every day, not for a single afternoon of judging.

paragraphs.function_zh: 描述圖片：用「比賽前一天」開場，以分詞片語寫出四項布置工作，最後由地上的工具推論大家的努力

self_assessment.explanation_zh: 圖片描述有動作與推論，經驗段有分工問題、解決方法與意外的感受，計畫具體並有讓步與理由（內容 5）；經驗帶出體會，再轉到計畫，結尾提出見解（組織 5）；with 獨立結構、分詞片語、by＋V-ing 等句型正確多樣（文法句構 5）；workshop、cozy、donated 用得貼切，但整體以常用字為主（字彙拼字 4）。總分 19，屬頂標版。

top.comment_zh: 第一段寫出掛紙鏈、貼口號海報、擺盆栽、畫黑板畫與地上的工具，分詞構句與細節豐富；第二段聖誕節準備的經驗（抽籤分工、剪四十片雪花）具體，用 If 句轉到閱讀角的計畫，有放什麼、放哪裡與兩個理由，讓步後以「教室是給每天待八小時的人用的」收尾。沒有語言錯誤。小瑕疵：經驗歸納出的 teamwork 和後面的計畫沒有連起來。

steady.comment_zh: 布置工作、聖誕節剪雪花的經驗、閱讀角計畫都有，文法正確、條理清楚。理由只有「舒適、可以閱讀放鬆」一項，說服力較弱；描述同時進行的畫面用 First／Then 略生硬；make 出現三次（making paper snowflakes、make a reading corner、make our classroom feel like home），字彙偏基本。

top.comment_zh: 第一段寫出站在椅子上掛紙鏈、貼班級標語海報、擺盆栽、畫黑板樹、地上的工具，完整而生動；第二段以聖誕布置時抽籤分工、自己剪了四十片雪花的經驗為例，再用 If we joined … 轉接提出閱讀角的計畫（書架、坐墊、燈串）與兩項理由，並承認缺點後回到教室屬於日常使用者。文法、用字皆佳，未見錯誤。

steady.comment_zh: 第一段把掛紙鏈、貼海報、擺盆栽、畫黑板樹與地上的工具寫齊；第二段有布置聖誕教室、負責剪雪花的經驗，並以 If our class joined … 轉接提出閱讀角的計畫（書架、坐墊、掛畫）與理由。文法正確，句型偏簡單；make 重複出現，理由較短。第一段用 First、Then 排列同時進行的動作，邏輯稍不貼切。
